title: Verify a tank, healer, and damage role contract

identity.purpose: small isolated combat fixture; no campaign roster membership

preparation.purpose: Create the exact small roster and capture role readiness before engagement.
steps: Allocate three wayfarer/out-of-roster characters and assert no unrelated party, raid, or campaign ownership.
Seed level, class, specialization, talents, gear, resources, and bags through the fixture adapter.
Create exactly the declared party or raid roster; do not add a hidden healer or tank.
Stage using a legitimate route or a fixture position seed recorded as setup only.
Read snapshot, combatlog, encounterlog, and role/loadout telemetry before the pull.

operation.purpose: Run one bounded native pull and measure role behavior.
operation.target_binding: engage only the exact fixture target entry or player supplied by the manifest; no nearest-target substitution
native_evidence_required: combatlog and encounterlog identify the exact target and pull window
the tank, healer, and damage characters are attributable by GUID
the healer emits native healing or assist events while the tank is engaged
damage characters emit native damage events
the result records survival, death, wipe, or timeout honestly

postconditions.predicate: the pull references the declared target entry/spawn and no substitute target
native tank, healer, and damage events are attributed to the exact fixture GUIDs
the fixture records defeated, survived, wiped, or timed_out; no success is inferred from movement or ok:true

current_bridge_can_prove: honest death or boss outcome when emitted
adapter_still_needed: seed exact talents, gear, resources, and target spawn
attribute threat/healing/avoidance by role if the current logs omit it

cleanup: end the pull through native combat resolution
disband or leave the fixture roster
deactivate fixture characters after persistence is stable
